pictures.name: SC1-Cave
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Sixth-century Italy: Saint Benedict, a lean young man about thirty with a short dark beard, close-cropped dark hair and calm grey eyes, in a plain black hooded wool monk’s habit, kneels in prayer at the mouth of a rough limestone cave high on a wooded mountainside above a deep green gorge. Early morning mist in the valley below, a single shaft of gold sunlight on his folded hands. Benedict in the middle of the frame. Peaceful, solitary, still. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SC2-The-Monks-Ask
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light. Outside a rough limestone mountain cave in sixth-century Italy, Saint Benedict (a lean man about thirty, short dark beard, close-cropped dark hair, calm grey eyes, plain black hooded wool habit) stands in the cave mouth, one hand raised in gentle warning. Facing him, a small group of five monks in grey-brown habits with rope belts, some older and bearded, plead with open hands, one kneeling. Late afternoon gold light, blue shadows in the gorge. Benedict in the middle. Earnest, uneasy mood. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SC3-The-Cup
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A plain stone refectory in a sixth-century Italian monastery at supper: a long rough wooden table with bread and clay bowls, monks in grey-brown habits seated along it. At the head sits Saint Benedict (a lean man about thirty, short dark beard, close-cropped dark hair, calm grey eyes, plain black hooded wool habit). A monk leans in and offers him a glass cup of red wine with both hands, eyes lowered and uneasy; other monks glance sideways. Oil lamps glow gold; deep blue shadows in the corners. The cup in the middle of the frame. Quiet tension, no violence. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SC4-The-Cup-Breaks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Same stone monastery refectory at supper. Saint Benedict (a lean man about thirty, short dark beard, close-cropped dark hair, calm grey eyes, plain black hooded wool habit) has just traced a small sign of the cross in the air with two fingers over a glass cup on the table, and the glass is bursting apart into sparkling fragments as if struck by a stone, the wine splashing in a dark red arc onto the wood. Benedict calm and still; the monks in grey-brown habits around the table recoil in shock. Gold lamplight catching the flying glass. The cup in the middle. Dramatic but gentle, no injury. No text, no letters, no logos.
